formation_structure.critical_unresolved_dependency: Ansel may receive consecutive artillery impacts before Steward enters acquisition range. One boosted Ansel heal is 506.8 against an 891 impact; a five-second interval containing only one self-heal cannot sustain repeated impacts from 1135 maximum HP. The supplied evidence does not establish a safe recipient and heal cadence for this revised geometry. This prevents a static survival certificate.
formation_structure.lower_outer_budget: Baseline Beagle received 1567.5 healing. Her 2035 HP makes an unhealed ordinary-damage budget plausible, but that total is conditional baseline evidence rather than an ablation result.
formation_structure.medical_exclusions: Hibiscus does not cover Ansel or Friston. Neither medic normally covers Beagle at [6,5]. No extra-heal talent is credited.
formation_structure.opening_cost: First four deployments cost 44 DP: Fang 10, Friston 3, Midnight 16, Melantha 15. Two medics add 34. Steward costs 18 and uses Melantha's actual seven-DP withdrawal refund.
formation_structure.splash_geometry: Steward is two tiles from Hibiscus and sqrt(10) tiles from Ansel; a 1.2-radius impact on Steward does not hit either medic. Ansel is sqrt(2) from Friston and opening Melantha.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: All eight IDs must remain normal-mode catalog operators with rarity 1-3. No substitutions or additional deployment IDs.
Never deploy on [1,2], [6,2], [1,6] or [6,6]. All deployment tiles are integer [row,col] with a cardinal direction.
A skill or retreat requires its operator to be deployed and alive. Death invalidates dependent scheduled actions; do not issue them to an absent operator.
Observe every Ansel artillery impact and actual intervening heals. A lethal or insufficient recovery sequence invalidates this candidate; arithmetic affordability does not repair it.
Melantha must finish both opening duties and withdraw alive. Death gives zero refund and breaks the 2011 Steward payment.
Retain Friston through lower armor and paired throwers. Retain central Melantha damage; do not infer that three-block capacity alone clears the fourth arrival.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Keep officers intercepted before they can attack waiting civilians; roadblock destruction is the release mechanism.
A born projectile retains its impact point and can hit later occupants. Artillery death or withdrawal of a target does not imply removal of an existing projectile.
Steward and Fang require their real 70-second cooldowns and fresh deployment payments. Current executor deployment costs remain 18 and 10; no client escalation rule is invented.

Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected deaths and exactly two safe protected arrivals. Operator deaths are recorded separately and evaluated by consequences.

Steward moves to [2,7] UP, inside both medic ranges and outside their splash radius. This is an unverified full-stage candidate.
